import numpy as np, json, math, time, sys
from joint import *
ml,data=load()
mu,sig,q=joint_fit(ml,data)
cells=sorted(ml)
rng=np.random.default_rng(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
R=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 30
Q={'q04':((0.001,512,'wsd',0.5,'bf16'),(0.001,512,'wsd',1.0,'bf16')),
   'q10':((0.001,512,'wsd',1.0,'bf16'),(0.001,1024,'wsd',1.0,'bf16')),
   'q03':((0.0003,512,'cosine',0.5,'bf16'),(0.001,512,'cosine',0.5,'bf16'))}
Rc={'r2':(0.001,512,'cosine',0.5,'bf16'),'r3':(0.001,512,'wsd',1.0,'bf16'),'r6':(0.001,512,'cosine',1.0,'bf16'),'r5':(0.0001,256,'cosine',0.5,'bf16')}
errs={}
def add(k,v): errs.setdefault(k,[]).append(v)
t=time.time()
for r in range(R):
    sd={}; truthG={}
    for k in cells:
        x=rng.normal(mu[k],sig,N)
        pre=rng.random(N)>q[k[1]]
        g=x>C
        keep=(~pre)&(~g)
        sd[k]=x[keep]
        truthG[k]=( (g&~pre).sum()/N, g.sum()/N )   # preempt-first realized, guard-first realized
    m2,s2,q2=joint_fit(ml,sd)
    for qid,(a,b) in Q.items():
        add(qid+'_joint',(m2[b]-m2[a])-(mu[b]-mu[a]))
    for rid,k in Rc.items():
        Pg=1-Phi((C-m2[k])/s2)
        add(rid+'_F1_vsGF',Pg-truthG[k][1]); add(rid+'_F1_vsPF',Pg-truthG[k][0])
        add(rid+'_F2_vsGF',q2[k[1]]*Pg-truthG[k][1]); add(rid+'_F2_vsPF',q2[k[1]]*Pg-truthG[k][0])
    print(r,time.time()-t,file=sys.stderr)
for k,v in errs.items(): print(k,'mean %.4f sd %.4f 5sd %.4f'%(np.mean(v),np.std(v),5*np.std(v)))
EOF
